title: Glittering Osaka prolongs French Open run with victory over Jovic
summary: For the first time in her career, world No.16 Naomi Osaka advanced to the fourth round of the French Open on Saturday with a 7-6 (7-5), 6-7 (3-7), 6-4 victory over American Iva Jovic.
contentText: US defending champion Coco Gauff was defeated by Russian-born Austrian Anastasia Potapova in the third round of the French Open on Saturday while Japan's Naomi Osaka advanced to the fourth round with a victory over American Iva Jovic.
